items.summary_zh: 蔡崇信乌镇发声：只有开源才能普及 AI，千问开源模型下载量突破40亿 https://www.caiwennews.com/
items.summary_en: At the Wuzhen summit, Joe Tsai argued that only open source can truly popularize AI and said downloads of the open-source Qwen models have passed 4 billion. The figure underpins the case that open-source releases are driving broad adoption among developers.
items.why_zh: 40 亿次下载凸显开源模型已成为 AI 普及的主要通道之一。
items.why_en: Four billion downloads underscores how open-weight models have become a major channel for AI adoption.

items.title_zh: 学会出价与捆绑：面向在线零售的后验采样智能体
items.title_en: Learning to bid and bundle: a posterior-sampling agent for online retail
items.summary_zh: 论文研究一个在线零售场景：商家推出一款易腐（保质期短）商品，需为赞助搜索的点击出价，同时把该商品与一款常备必需品打包折扣销售，并展示剩余库存以提升消费者的支付意愿。商家既不知道点击量如何随出价变化，也不清楚市场规模强弱与分散程度，只能从被自身决策“截断”的数据中学习——出价为零时无法观测付费点击，而选择又只发生在有点击之后。作者为此设计了一个后验采样（posterior-sampling）智能体：每一期从精确后验中抽取一个市场状态并据此决策，从而在探索与利用之间取得平衡。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2611.00165v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: An online retailer launching a perishable product bids for sponsored-search clicks, discounts a bundle with an always-stocked staple and displays its remaining stock, which raises willingness to pay. It knows neither how clicks respond to its bid nor how strong and dispersed its market is, and learns both over repeated seasons from data its own decisions censor: a zero bid reveals nothing about paid clicks, and choices follow only clicks. We design a posterior-sampling agent for it. Each period it draws a market from an exact posterior and posts…
items.why_zh: 它把“出价—捆绑—库存展示”放进同一个带截断反馈的学习框架，为在线零售的 AI 定价与投放提供了有理论依据的决策方法。
items.why_en: It unifies bidding, bundling and stock display in one learning framework with censored feedback, offering a principled approach to AI-driven retail pricing and ad spend.

items.title_zh: 要不要用 Jev：System-1 决策模型能否取代 LLM 评审？
items.title_en: To Jev or Not to Jev: When Can System-1 Decision Models Replace LLM Judges?
items.summary_zh: 论文评估了一类“System-1”决策模型（如 TypeSafe 的 Jev）：它们针对文本回答有固定类型的问题（是/否、多选或序数评分），在单次前向传播中直接输出经过校准的概率，且不生成文本，因此被视为 LLM-as-a-judge 场景的低成本候选方案。研究按预先设定的协议选出 14 个决策模型，与四个生成式评审（Claude Haiku 5.5、带与不带推理的 GPT-5.6、开启思考的 Claude Opus 5.5）在 11 个既有评审基准上对比。结果显示，14 个模型中有 5 个在统计意义上与生成式评审难以区分。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2611.00505v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Decision models such as TypeSafe's Jev answer typed questions about a text (yes/no, multiple choice, or an ordinal score) with calibrated probabilities in a single forward pass and without generating text, which makes them an inexpensive candidate for LLM-as-a-judge workloads. We evaluate 14 System-1 decision models, selected with a pre-stated protocol, against four generative judges (Claude Haiku 5.5, GPT-5.6 with and without reasoning, and Claude Opus 5.5 with thinking) on eleven established judge benchmarks. Five of the 14 are statistically in…
items.why_zh: 若评审任务可由单次前向的低成本模型完成，将显著降低 AI 评测与数据标注的开销，并动摇“评审必须用大模型”的默认假设。
items.why_en: If judging can be done by cheap single-pass models, the cost of AI evaluation and data annotation drops sharply, challenging the assumption that judges must be large generative models.

items.title_zh: 气球效应：封堵一条通道，隐藏特征会另寻出口
items.title_en: A balloon effect: ban one channel and a hidden trait finds another
items.summary_zh: 研究发现，用其他模型的输出训练语言模型时，学生模型可能习得输出中从未明说的特征，例如借一串数字列表传递对某种动物的偏好，这类“潜意识学习”（subliminal learning）会把不受欢迎的特征传递下去。直觉上的防御是找出并禁用特征显现所依赖的 token，但特征痕迹在封禁下如何变化、学生模型究竟学到了什么，此前并无定论。作者在两个压力测试（偏好链与名字链）中，跨两个模型、六种输出格式逐一封堵特征的出口，发现封堵一条通道后，隐藏特征会像气球一样从另一条通道浮现。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2611.02509v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Language models trained on the outputs of other models can acquire traits that those outputs never mention, such as a preference for an animal carried by lists of numbers. Such subliminal learning can pass on unwanted traits. The intuitive defence is to find and forbid the tokens through which a trait shows, but how a trait's trace behaves under such bans, and what of it a student learns, has not been resolved. We closed a trait's outlets one by one in two stress tests, a preference chain and a name chain, across two models, six output formats an…
items.why_zh: 它表明简单禁用某些 token 无法阻止不良特征的隐性传播，对模型蒸馏与合成数据安全提出了更严峻的警示。
items.why_en: It shows token-level bans cannot stop hidden trait transmission, a serious warning for model distillation and synthetic-data safety.

items.title_zh: 用协作智能衡量 AI 智能体作为队友的表现
items.title_en: Measuring AI Agents as Teammates with Collaborative Intelligence
items.summary_zh: AI 的进展常以单个模型独立完成任务的能力来衡量，但由多个 AI 智能体组成的团队已开始在科学、医学、数学和软件工程领域取得突破与发现。随着 AI 越来越多地与智能体和人类组成团队工作，协作能力正成为其智能的核心组成部分，而人类团队研究已对此测量了数十年。受此启发，作者提出“协作智能基准”（Collaborative Intelligence Benchmark），用于衡量 AI 智能体作为队友的表现，其中包含覆盖多类任务的 240 项任务。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2611.02633v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Progress in AI is often measured by what a single model can do on its own. Yet teams of AI agents are starting to make breakthroughs and discoveries in science, medicine, mathematics and software engineering. As AI begins to work in teams of agents and people, the ability to collaborate becomes a core part of their intelligence. Research on human teams has measured this ability for decades. Inspired by this, we introduce the Collaborative Intelligence Benchmark, which measures how well an AI agent works as a teammate. It contains 240 tasks across…
items.why_zh: 它为“智能体团队”提供了可比较的评测标准，把协作能力从抽象概念变成可测量的指标。
items.why_en: It turns collaboration into a measurable, comparable metric just as multi-agent systems move from demos into real scientific and engineering work.

items.title_zh: 离线近似值迭代：卫星星座部署的强化学习方法
items.title_en: Offline Approximate Value Iteration: A Reinforcement Learning Approach for Satellite Constellation Deployment
items.summary_zh: 该论文提出一种基于强化学习的近似动态规划方法，用于在发射失败和卫星故障等不确定性下优化Walker型卫星星座的部署。研究将问题建模为马尔可夫决策过程，纳入低注入轨道发射、连续低推力轨道抬升和可变卫星载荷等要素。求解采用离线近似值迭代，并结合基函数线性函数逼近与动作剪枝策略。该方法旨在提升星座部署在不确定环境下的决策效率与鲁棒性。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2611.02809v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: This paper introduces a reinforcement learning-based approximate dynamic programming approach to optimize the deployment of Walker-type satellite constellations under uncertainties, including launch failures and satellite malfunctions. We formulate the problem as a Markov Decision Process that incorporates low-injection orbit launches, continuous low-thrust orbit raising, and variable satellite loads. We adopt the offline approximate value iteration solution method, using linear function approximation with basis functions and action pruning strat…
items.why_zh: 为卫星星座部署提供可应对不确定性的强化学习决策框架，有望降低发射与运维风险。
items.why_en: It offers a reinforcement learning decision framework for satellite constellation deployment under uncertainty, potentially reducing launch and operational risks.

items.title_zh: 面向测试时推理的价值条件提案获取
items.title_en: Value-Conditioned Proposal Acquisition for Test-Time Reasoning
items.summary_zh: 论文指出，采样与选择虽能在候选池内分配测试时计算，却无法找回从未进入池子的正确答案。为此作者提出ValueFormation，一种测试时策略：在主干模型每次生成后决定停止、继续采样，还是从异构推理专家处获取一个提案。三种动作在统一的成本正则化价值尺度上比较，该尺度由投票状态特征学习得到，且校准跨任务与主干模型冻结；获取的提案需通过冻结的后续机制才被接受。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2611.02852v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Sampling and selection spend test-time compute inside a candidate pool, but they cannot recover a correct answer that never enters it. We introduce ValueFormation, a test-time policy that decides after each primary-model draw whether to stop, continue sampling, or acquire one proposal from a heterogeneous reasoning specialist. The three actions are compared on one cost-regularized value scale learned from vote-state features; the calibration is frozen across tasks and primary models, and acquired proposals are accepted only through a frozen poste…
items.why_zh: 提升测试时推理在有限算力下跳出候选池局限、按价值决定是否引入外部专家提案的能力。
items.why_en: It helps test-time reasoning escape candidate-pool limits under limited compute by deciding when to acquire external specialist proposals.

items.title_zh: LLM推理能耗的SIMPLE定律
items.title_en: The SIMPLE Law for Energy Cost of LLM Inference
items.summary_zh: 生成式AI按token计费，但不同token的能耗并不相同。每个token进入KV-cache都会推高后续token的成本，使能耗沿序列非线性增长，尽管这些token看起来相同。现有最准确的SOTA模型只是拟合而非定律，需要针对每个LLM单独拟合。论文推导出以架构超参数为变量的LLM推理计算与内存访问复杂度闭式表达式，试图给出可解释的能耗“定律”。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2611.03330v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Generative AI is billed per token, yet tokens are not equally expensive. Each token enters the KV-cache and raises the cost of those that follow, so energy grows non-linearly along a sequence whose tokens look identical. No analytical model states what a token costs, and the most accurate SOTA model is a fit, not a law: it absorbs architecture into fitted coefficients, requiring per-LLM fitting. We derive closed-form expressions of the computational and memory-access complexity of LLM inference in terms of architectural hyperparameters, covering…
items.why_zh: 为LLM推理能耗提供可解析、可跨模型比较的刻画，有助于成本核算与架构优化。
items.why_en: It provides an analytical and comparable characterization of LLM inference energy, aiding cost accounting and architecture optimization.

items.title_zh: 混合方法探索影响城市社区犯罪举报应用采用的社会技术因素
items.title_en: Mixed-Methods Exploration of Sociotechnical Factors to Improve Adoption of Crime-Reporting Apps in Urban Communities
items.summary_zh: 犯罪举报类移动应用有助提升城市社区安全与参与，但采用率仍低，部分原因是开发者更重视技术功能而忽视居民的社会现实。该研究采用探索性序贯混合方法，识别并验证推动应用采用的社会技术因素。通过两组焦点小组和对660条应用评论的分析，研究发现用户最初的有用感会消退，而持续参与取决于感知价值（PV），后者由六个维度构成。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2611.03376v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Crime-reporting mobile applications can enhance community safety and engagement in urban areas, yet their adoption remains low, partly because developers prioritize technological features over residents' social realities. This study used an exploratory sequential mixed-methods design to identify and validate the sociotechnical factors that drive adoption. Two focus groups and an analysis of 660 app reviews revealed that users' initial sense of usefulness fades, whereas sustained engagement depends on perceived value (PV), comprising six dimension…
items.why_zh: 强调社会技术因素而非仅技术功能，为提升社区犯罪举报应用的实际采用提供依据。
items.why_en: It highlights sociotechnical factors beyond technical features, informing efforts to improve real-world adoption of community crime-reporting apps.

items.title_zh: 筛选LLM生成假设可提升真实性：一项在NAS-Bench-201与HPOBench上的预注册研究
items.title_en: Selecting LLM-Generated Hypotheses Raises Truth Beyond What an LLM Panel Expects: A Pre-registered Study on NAS-Bench-201 and HPOBench
items.summary_zh: LLM科研构思系统追求既真实又不显而易见的假设，但这两点通常都难以检验。研究构建了一个可同时检验二者的试验平台：生成器针对两个完整表格化基准NAS-Bench-201和HPOBench提出条件交互声明，每条声明都对照表格精确验证，其非显而易见性则用其他LLM校准出的盲先验评分。超额真实性指标衡量一次运行中的声明比该LLM评审团预期更常成立的程度。该预注册研究系列评估了筛选LLM生成假设的效果。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2611.00643v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: LLM research-ideation systems aim for hypotheses that are both true and non-obvious, yet neither property can normally be checked. We build a testbed in which both can. Generators propose conditional interaction claims about two fully tabulated benchmarks, NAS-Bench-201 and HPOBench; every claim is verified exactly against the tables, and its non-obviousness is scored against a calibrated blind prior elicited from other LLMs. Excess truth measures how much more often a run's claims hold than this panel expects. Across a series of pre-registered…
items.why_zh: 提供可精确验证真实性与新颖性的测试平台，表明筛选能提高LLM生成假设的可信度。
items.why_en: It provides a testbed for exactly verifying truth and novelty, showing that selection can raise the credibility of LLM-generated hypotheses.

items.title_zh: Ripple：面向具身推理的截止时间感知CPU-GPU共享
items.title_en: Ripple: Deadline-Aware CPU-GPU Sharing for Embodied Inference
items.summary_zh: 统一内存边缘设备越来越多地同时运行LLM/VLM推理和感知控制等时间关键的CPU任务。GPU内存流量可能压垮这些任务，但DGX Spark等平台既不暴露带宽计数器，也不支持直接带宽调节。为此作者提出Ripple——一种CPU-GPU协同调度器，将模型推导的GPU内存量与CPU完成反馈结合来调节干扰。Ripple把推理切分为可暂停的逐层单元，并把每个CPU任务的截止时间余量转换为GPU字节预算，从而决定准入。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2611.01067v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Unified-memory edge devices increasingly run LLM/VLM inference alongside time-critical CPU tasks for perception and control. GPU memory traffic can overwhelm these tasks, yet platforms such as DGX Spark expose neither bandwidth counters nor direct bandwidth regulation. We present Ripple, a CPU-GPU co-scheduler that combines model-derived GPU memory volumes with CPU completion feedback to regulate interference. Ripple divides inference into pausable, layer-based units and translates each CPU job's deadline slack into a GPU-byte budget, admitting…
items.why_zh: 在缺乏硬件带宽控制接口的边缘平台上保障具身推理中关键CPU任务的时延。
items.why_en: It protects the latency of critical CPU tasks in embodied inference on edge platforms lacking hardware bandwidth control interfaces.

items.title_zh: 大语言模型智能体能通过观看教学视频学习吗？
items.title_en: Can Large Language Model Agents Learn by Watching Tutorial Videos?
items.summary_zh: 人类能从书籍和教学视频中持续获取知识，并把理解迁移到未来任务。每天有数百万条教学视频上传到网上，但LLM智能体仍无法利用这一不断扩张的人类教学资源：它们的能力在训练后即被冻结，而大规模参数更新成本过高。论文由此提出核心问题：LLM智能体能否在不更新参数的情况下，从海量教学视频中学习？作者提出了一种方法框架来探索这一问题。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2611.01460v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Humans continuously acquire knowledge from carefully crafted materials such as books and tutorial videos, carrying that understanding into future tasks. Millions of such instructional videos are uploaded online every day, yet LLM agents remain unable to exploit this ever-expanding wealth of human teaching. Their capabilities are frozen after training, while parameter updates at scale remain prohibitively expensive. This raises the central question: can LLM agents learn from this vast instructional resource without parameter updates? We introduc…
items.why_zh: 探索LLM智能体能否像人一样从海量教学视频中持续学习，而不必昂贵地更新参数。
items.why_en: It explores whether LLM agents can continually learn from vast instructional videos like humans, without costly parameter updates.

items.title_zh: 智能体工作流中有原则的人机协作
items.title_en: Principled Human-AI Collaboration in Agentic Workflows
items.summary_zh: 采用AI的组织面临一个难题：哪些输出可以在不经人工审核的情况下发布，同时仍达到人类专家质量标准。论文提出一个统计框架，在人类专家与黑盒“生成—验证”工作流之间分配任务，其中AI生成的答案会经过多轮验证和修订。部署前，人类专家评估部分输出，其判断用于校准验证器阈值和尝试次数。该方法据此选择期望表现最优的策略。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2611.01566v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Organizations adopting AI face the challenge of deciding which outputs can be released without human review while meeting the quality standards of human experts. We develop a statistical framework for delegating tasks between experts and black-box generate-verify workflows, in which AI-generated answers are verified and revised over multiple rounds. Before deployment, human experts evaluate selected outputs, and their judgments are used to calibrate the verifier threshold and number of attempts. Our method selects the policy with the highest es…
items.why_zh: 为组织在智能体工作流中安全地决定人工审核范围提供可校准的统计依据。
items.why_en: It gives organizations a calibratable statistical basis for deciding the scope of human review in agentic workflows safely.

items.title_zh: 乌尔都语 Nastaliq 手写识别基准：六系统零微调评测
items.title_en: Benchmarking Vision-Language Models for Urdu Nastaliq Handwriting Recognition
items.summary_zh: 乌尔都语 Nastaliq 手写体因草书连写、没有固定基线和清晰字符边界而难以识别。研究者在 UNHD 数据集上对六套系统进行零微调评测：Tesseract 默认配置、基于印刷体乌尔都语训练的 UTRNet-Large、两个开源视觉语言模型和两个商用视觉语言模型。评测使用 2,465 张单行图像（Part A），四个 VLM 接收相同固定提示，解码温度设为 0。该工作为通用 VLM 与专用 OCR 系统在这一文字上的比较提供了统一基准。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2611.01635v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Handwritten Urdu is hard to recognize because the cursive Nastaliq script has no fixed baseline and no clear character boundaries. We benchmark six systems on the Urdu Nastaliq Handwritten Dataset (UNHD): Tesseract (default configuration), a script-specific recognizer trained on printed Urdu (UTRNet-Large), two open-source vision-language models (VLMs), and two commercial VLMs. All six systems are evaluated without fine-tuning on 2,465 single-line images (Part A), and the four VLMs receive the same fixed prompt (decoding uses temperature 0 wher…
items.why_zh: Nastaliq 手写识别长期缺乏统一评测，该基准有助于衡量通用视觉语言模型与专用 OCR 的真实能力边界。
items.why_en: Nastaliq handwriting recognition lacks standardized evaluation, and this benchmark helps assess the real capability limits of general VLMs versus specialized OCR systems.

items.title_zh: AgenticMobility：多智能体出行动力学开源平台
items.title_en: AgenticMobility: An Open-Source Platform for Multi-AI-Agent Mobility Dynamics
items.summary_zh: AgenticMobility 是一个开源实验平台，用于研究出行 AI 智能体及其他 AI 智能体如何交互、通过反复经验适应，并共同塑造出行结果。平台中的持久化智能体在多轮交互中保留身份和相关状态，并通过显式接口定义信息访问方式。该平台面向个体出行决策、交通状况与政策干预随时间相互影响的问题，为交通管理政策实验提供可复现的多智能体环境。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2611.01918v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Understanding mobility dynamics and the effects of urban transportation management policies requires examining how individual travel decisions, traffic conditions, and policy interventions influence one another over time. We present AgenticMobility, an open-source experimental platform for studying how mobility AI agents and other AI agents interact, adapt through repeated experience, and collectively shape mobility outcomes. Persistent agents retain identities and relevant states across rounds, with explicit interfaces defining information acc…
items.why_zh: 把多智能体 AI 引入出行行为与交通政策仿真，为理解政策干预的长期动态提供开放实验基础设施。
items.why_en: It brings multi-agent AI into mobility behavior and transportation policy simulation, offering open infrastructure for understanding long-term policy dynamics.

items.title_zh: 混合检索、NLI 与开源 LLM 用于科学主张验证的实验研究
items.title_en: An Experimental Study of Hybrid Retrieval, NLI and Open-source LLMs for Scientific Claim Verification
items.summary_zh: 该研究关注科学主张验证：判断来源文本支持、反驳某主张，还是证据不足。NLI 模型能判断单句支持或反驳，但当证据分散在多个句子时表现受限；LLM 可跨句推理，却可能得出文本不支持的结论。作者实验测试一种保守融合规则——只有在条件满足时才标注“支持”或“反驳”，并结合混合检索、NLI 与开源 LLM。目标是提高科学主张验证的可靠性，减少无依据的模型判断。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2611.03093v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Claim verification is the task of deciding whether a source text supports a claim, contradicts it, or lacks sufficient evidence. Natural Language Inference (NLI) models can judge whether a single sentence supports or contradicts a claim, but they struggle when the evidence is spread across several sentences. Conversely, Large Language Models (LLMs) can reason across sentences, but may draw conclusions the text does not support. In this experimental study, we test whether a conservative fusion rule, labeling a claim Support or Contradict only wh…
items.why_zh: 科学主张验证需要兼顾证据检索与可靠推理，该研究探索用保守融合策略约束 LLM 的过度推断。
items.why_en: Scientific claim verification requires reliable evidence retrieval and reasoning, and this work explores conservative fusion to constrain unsupported LLM inferences.

items.title_zh: 智能体框架中的 MCP 工具投毒：跨框架实测
items.title_en: MCP Tool Poisoning in Agentic AI Frameworks: A Cross-Framework Measurement Study
items.summary_zh: MCP 让智能体 AI 框架把语言模型连接到外部工具提供方，但工具描述、schema 字段和响应数据等攻击者可控内容会在未经校验的情况下进入模型上下文。已有基准多衡量模型是否服从投毒指令，却未确认真实工具执行。该研究首次在真实工具执行条件下跨框架测量 MCP 工具投毒，并用 25 类根因分类法统一既有分类，同时开源了 mcpvenom 工具。它把智能体工具生态中的安全风险放到可测量、可比较的框架下。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2611.03555v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: The Model Context Protocol (MCP) lets agentic AI frameworks connect language models to external tool providers, but it carries attacker-controlled content (tool descriptions, schema fields, and response data) into model context without validation. Prior benchmarks measure model compliance with poisoned instructions without confirming real execution. We present the first cross-framework measurement of MCP tool poisoning with real tool execution. A 25-class root-cause taxonomy unifies prior classifications, and the open-source tool mcpvenom drive…
items.why_zh: MCP 已成为智能体连接工具的关键协议，真实执行层面的跨框架测量有助于暴露并系统化工具投毒风险。
items.why_en: MCP is becoming a key protocol for connecting agents to tools, and real-execution cross-framework measurement helps expose and systematize tool-poisoning risks.

items.title_zh: 有限资源下的表征获取
items.title_en: Representational Acquisition Under Bounded Resources
items.summary_zh: 该理论研究有限资源下学习者获取表征时面临的存储与访问权衡：要保证习得内容可持续使用，不同存储端点会迫使系统采用不同的物理组织方式。针对精确概念学习任务，作者在常数因子内确定了存储—读取曲线。一次读取的复合查询会迫使答案特定单元和指数级更新成本，而一比特、顺序无关的更新则迫使事实特定单元。在最小存储容量下还存在稳健对应结果。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2603.21736v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: A learner's obligation to keep acquired content usable imposes a storage-access tradeoff, with exact endpoints that force different physical organizations. For an exact concept-learning task, we determine the storage-read curve within a constant factor. One-read compound queries force answer-specific cells and exponentially costly updates; one-bit, order-independent updates instead force fact-specific cells. At minimum storage capacity, a robust counterpart holds: when update stretch is averaged uniformly over all semantic cube edges, small e…
items.why_zh: 它把“学到的表征如何被保存和调用”形式化，为资源受限学习系统的存储与更新设计提供理论边界。
items.why_en: It formalizes how acquired representations are stored and accessed, providing theoretical bounds for memory and update design in resource-constrained learning systems.

items.title_zh: ReClaim：从全国医疗索赔中释放真实世界证据的基础模型
items.title_en: Foundation Models to Unlock Real-World Evidence from Nationwide Medical Claims
items.summary_zh: 真实世界数据日益影响监管和临床决策，而行政索赔数据持续追踪参保者的诊疗与费用，却很少用于医疗基础模型。研究提出 ReClaim，一组基于 MarketScan 研究数据库中 438 亿条索赔记录、覆盖超过 2 亿参保者的生成式基础模型。ReClaim 通过从零预训练联合学习诊断、手术、药物和支出信息。该工作旨在释放全国性医疗索赔数据中的真实世界证据价值。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2605.02740v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Real-world data increasingly inform regulatory and clinical decisions. Administrative claims, among their major sources, continuously track care and its cost across providers throughout enrollment, yet remain largely unexplored for healthcare foundation models. Here we present ReClaim, a family of generative foundation models built on 43.8 billion claims records from more than 200 million enrollees in the MarketScan Research Databases. ReClaim learns diagnoses, procedures, medications and expenditure jointly through pre-training from scratch,…
items.why_zh: 医疗索赔数据规模大且连续，专用基础模型有望把行政数据转化为可用于监管与临床决策的真实世界证据。
items.why_en: Medical claims are large-scale and continuous, and dedicated foundation models could turn administrative data into real-world evidence for regulatory and clinical decisions.

items.title_zh: 同构还不够：Lean 可验证代码生成的智能体审计
items.title_en: Isomorphism Is Not Enough: An Agentic Audit of Verified Code Generation in Lean
items.summary_zh: 研究审计了 Lean 4 可验证代码生成基准 CLEVER，使用基于 Claude Opus 4.6、GPT-5.4 和 Kimi K2.5 的三个独立智能体栈。审计发现，161 个条目中有 80 个的参考规范可能存在错误，且这些规范均被基准作者接受。作者据此提炼了错误分类法，并讨论现有基准衡量程序验证能力的可靠性。标题强调：仅靠同构或形式化外壳不足以保证评测有效。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2605.23772v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Agentic systems have recently emerged as state-of-the-art approaches for automated theorem proving in formal mathematics. To assess how far these capabilities extend to program verification and how reliably existing benchmarks can measure them, we audit CLEVER, a Lean 4 benchmark for verifiable code generation, using three independent agentic stacks based on Claude Opus 4.6, GPT-5.4, and Kimi K2.5. Our audit finds arguably erroneous reference specifications in 80 of 161 entries, each accepted by the benchmark's authors, distills a taxonomy of…
items.why_zh: 可验证代码生成依赖高质量参考规范；审计揭示基准本身可能系统性高估或误判智能体的程序验证能力。
items.why_en: Verified code generation depends on high-quality reference specifications, and the audit shows benchmarks may systematically overestimate or misjudge agents' verification capabilities.

items.title_zh: 地图使用者与制图者：习得表征的认知归因范围
items.title_en: Map Users and Mapmakers: The Scope of Cognitive Attribution from Acquired Representations
items.summary_zh: 论文讨论习得表征如何扩展系统的认知能力，以及这种扩展的边界：系统获得某种表征，并不等于同时获得产生该表征所运用的能力。作者提出一个五部分归因表，区分有效追踪、习得结构的应用、从显式规范获取、从识别性观察获取，以及保持与重用。表中每一项都对应一项正向能力承诺和进一步需满足的主张。该框架用于更精确地界定从习得表征进行认知归因的范围。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.13879v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: An acquired representation can enlarge a system's cognitive repertoire without transferring the capacities exercised in producing that representation. This paper develops a framework for specifying that enlargement and its limits. Its central contribution is a five-part attribution table distinguishing effective tracking, application of acquired structures, acquisition from explicit specifications, acquisition from identifying observations, and retention and reuse. Each entry identifies a positive capacity commitment and a further claim requi…
items.why_zh: 它澄清了“系统拥有某种表征”与“系统具备相关认知能力”之间的差距，为 AI 表征研究中的能力归因提供分析工具。
items.why_en: It clarifies the gap between possessing a representation and having the associated cognitive capacities, offering an analytical tool for cognitive attribution in AI representation research.

items.title_zh: 不止是捏造：AI 研究智能体论文中的数字误归属
items.title_en: Beyond fabrication: Misattributed numbers in papers written by AI research agents
items.summary_zh: 该论文重新分析了近期一个公开 AI 研究智能体基准中全部 540 条已发布判定结果（涉及九个智能体、十五个开放研究问题，原文摘要在此处截断）。作者指出，现有基准多由单个大模型充当评审，只给出“不合格”结论，却不解释失败的性质；而现有检查要么只测论文内部一致性，要么只确认某个数值是否在智能体输出中的某处出现过。论文由此把注意力引向“数字误归属”这一被忽视的失败模式：数值确有出处，却被归到了错误的来源，因而与凭空捏造不同。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.38691v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Verifying numerical claims in research written by AI agents is an important but challenging problem. Recent benchmarks show that many agent-written papers fail integrity checks, but such verdicts, often produced by a single LLM judge, identify failure without explaining its nature, and existing checks either test a paper for internal consistency or test whether a reported value appears somewhere in an agent's output. We re-analyze all 540 released judgments from a recent public benchmark of AI research agents (nine agents, fifteen open resear…
items.why_zh: 只有把“捏造”与“误归属”区分开，对 AI 研究智能体的自动评审才能从简单打分走向可诊断、可纠错。
items.why_en: Distinguishing misattribution from fabrication lets automated reviews of AI research agents move from binary verdicts to diagnosable, correctable feedback.

items.title_zh: AuthRank：以来源可信度评分抵御威胁情报 LLM 流水线投毒
items.title_en: AuthRank: Scoring Source Credibility to Counter Poisoning in CTI LLM Pipelines
items.summary_zh: 大模型流水线已成为处理网络威胁情报（CTI）的关键手段，可从公开来源与报告中快速提取最新威胁信息供实时处理。但这类流水线容易遭受投毒攻击，而以往提出的防御在 CTI 场景下可能失效：威胁信息往往完全新颖，攻击者也容易模仿其文体惯例。作者提出，通过引入来源可信度评分来提升 LLM 流水线的鲁棒性，并以 AuthRank 作为具体方案。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2510.20768v3 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Large Language Model (LLM) pipelines have become essential for processing Cyber Threat Intelligence (CTI) to quickly extract updated threat information from open source feeds and reports for real time processing. However, these pipelines are susceptible to poisoning attacks, and previously proposed defenses can fail for CTI contexts as cyber threat information is often completely novel, and attackers can easily mimic the stylistic conventions. We propose that the robustness of LLM pipelines can be improved by applying source credibility…
items.why_zh: 在信息全新且易被仿写的威胁情报领域，把“来源可信度”纳入流水线，为防御投毒提供了不依赖内容风格的思路。
items.why_en: In a domain where content is novel and easily imitated, folding source credibility into the pipeline offers a poisoning defense that does not rely on stylistic cues.

items.title_zh: 面向医疗 AI 的层级感知多模态遗忘
items.title_en: Hierarchy-Aware Multimodal Unlearning for Medical AI
items.summary_zh: 多模态大模型正越来越多地进入医疗等敏感领域，而 HIPAA、GDPR 等隐私法规要求移除特定个人或机构的数据，这推动了“机器遗忘”研究，即消除目标数据对已训练模型的影响。然而现有遗忘基准未能反映真实医疗数据的层级化与多模态结构，限制了在实际场景中评估遗忘效果的能力。为此，作者构建了面向医疗 AI 的层级感知多模态遗忘方法与评测框架。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2512.09867v4 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) are increasingly used in sensitive domains such as medical AI, where privacy regulations, including HIPAA and GDPR, require the removal of specific individuals' or institutions' data. This motivates machine unlearning, which aims to remove the influence of target data from a trained model. However, existing unlearning benchmarks fail to reflect the hierarchical and multimodal structure of real-world medical data, limiting their ability to properly evaluate unlearning in practice. Therefore, we in…
items.why_zh: 医疗数据的层级与多模态特性决定了通用遗忘基准会高估效果，面向该结构的评测是把遗忘技术推向合规落地的前提。
items.why_en: Because medical data is hierarchical and multimodal, generic unlearning benchmarks overstate success; structure-aware evaluation is a precondition for regulatory deployment.

items.title_zh: 用嵌入一致性调节实现小型语言模型中的持久语义路由
items.title_en: Embedding Consistency Regulation for Persistent Semantic Routing in Compact Language Models
items.summary_zh: 语言模型越来越多地被部署在内存与算力紧张的环境中，常需在解码前先为输入分配语义路由（如语言、语气或意图）。但作者指出，这些路由未必会持续体现在生成的回答中，并把这一现象称为“持久语义路由”问题。他们以“嵌入一致性调节”（ECR）作为最小化探针：借助冻结的嵌入模型为每个输入生成一段短离散前缀，并在训练与推理时采用相同的前缀构造方式。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2601.00543v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Language models are increasingly deployed under tight memory and compute constraints, where semantic routes (e.g., language, tone, or intent) may be assigned before decoding. However, these routes may not remain reflected in generated responses. We study this phenomenon as \emph{persistent semantic routing}. We investigate this property using Embedding Consistency Regulation (ECR) as a minimal probe. ECR derives a short discrete prefix for each input using a frozen embedding model and applies the same prefix construction during both tra…
items.why_zh: 路由“分配了却没生效”会直接破坏受限部署下的可控性，该研究把这个隐蔽问题显式化并给出轻量探测手段。
items.why_en: Routes that are assigned but not honored undermine controllability in constrained deployments; this work makes the hidden failure explicit and offers a lightweight probe.

items.title_zh: 公开医疗视觉语言模型的选择性关联精度
items.title_en: Selective Linkage Precision for Released Medical Vision-Language Models
items.summary_zh: 医院可能公开去标识化的胸片，同时限制对相应报告的访问。但若攻击者已掌握同一人群的报告及其元数据，就可能借助视觉语言模型把图像重新匹配到报告上。作者提出“选择性关联精度”指标，在按可得属性过滤候选人后，衡量最高置信度查询中正确匹配的比例。在 8 个公开 VLM 与 3 个胸片数据集上，整体 Recall@1 最高仅为 0.40%，但这一指标会掩盖高置信区间内的集中风险。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2606.02276v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Hospitals may release de-identified chest radiographs while restricting access to their reports. An attacker who already has reports from the same population and their metadata can use a vision-language model (VLM) to match images to reports. We introduce selective linkage precision, which measures correct matches among the highest-confidence queries after filtering candidates by the available attributes. Across 8 public VLMs and 3 chest radiograph datasets, the maximum whole-pool Recall@1 is 0.40%. However, this metric averages over ev…
items.why_zh: 整体重识别率虽低，但风险集中在少数高置信匹配上，这提醒去标识化影像的发布需按“最坏情况”而非平均值来评估。
items.why_en: Overall re-identification rates are low, but risk concentrates in a few high-confidence matches, so de-identified image release should be judged by worst-case rather than average performance.

items.title_zh: 重思医学影像 AI：假设、现实与转向以医生为中心的智能体推理
items.title_en: Rethinking AI in Medical Imaging: Assumptions, Reality, and Reframing; Towards Physician-Centered Agentic Reasoning
items.summary_zh: 医学影像长期是临床 AI 的主要试验场，但十余年的密集研究并未转化为与投入相称的临床影响力。作者认为，这一落差主要不是算法性能不足、监管不到位或可解释性欠缺造成的，而是源于 AI 系统的设计与评估方式同临床决策方式之间的结构性错位。文章归纳出 8 个相互关联的错位维度（例如过度依赖纯像素模型等），并主张转向以医生为中心的智能体推理框架。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2607.27428v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Medical imaging has served as primary proving ground for clinical AI, yet a decade of intense research has not translated into proportionate bedside impact. We argue that this gap is not primarily a product of insufficient algorithmic performance, inadequate regulation, or limited explainability. Rather, it reflects a structural misalignment, between how AI systems are designed and evaluated, and how clinical decisions are made. This work identifies 8 interconnected dimensions of this misalignment: 1) the dominance of pixel-only models…
items.why_zh: 这是一篇立场鲜明的反思之作：如果错位出在问题设定与评估范式上，继续堆算力与刷指标就难以带来临床价值。
items.why_en: This position paper argues that if the misalignment lies in problem framing and evaluation, more compute and better benchmarks alone will not deliver clinical value.

items.title_zh: 面向大模型对齐的排名感知差分隐私列表式偏好发布
items.title_en: Rank-Aware Differentially Private Release of Listwise Preferences for LLM Alignment
items.summary_zh: 列表式偏好反馈比成对比较为大模型对齐提供更丰富的监督信号，但一份完整排名也会暴露更多敏感的用户偏好。现有隐私保护对齐方法主要针对成对反馈，列表式对齐在本地差分隐私（LDP）下的研究仍是空白。将 LDP 扩展到该领域面临一个关键难题：完整排名空间敏感度过高，需要注入过多噪声，从而抵消列表式监督带来的收益。作者因此提出排名感知的隐私发布方法。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2610.37682v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Listwise preference feedback offers richer supervision for large language model (LLMs) alignment than pairwise comparisons, but a full ranking also reveals more sensitive user preferences. Existing privacy-preserving alignment methods focus mainly on pairwise feedback, while listwise alignment under local differential privacy (LDP) remains unexplored. Extending LDP to this listwise domain raises a critical challenge: the high sensitivity of the full ranking space demands excessive noise, neutralizing the benefits of listwise supervision…
items.why_zh: 让用户偏好数据在本地差分隐私下仍可用于列表式对齐，是隐私合规与对齐质量之间必须打通的一环。
items.why_en: Making listwise preference data usable under local differential privacy is essential to reconciling privacy compliance with alignment quality.

items.title_zh: 线性 bandit 的两全 FTRL：信息获取、污染与几何结构的交互
items.title_en: Best-of-Both-Worlds FTRL for Linear Bandits: The Interplay of Information Acquisition, Corruption, and Geometry
items.summary_zh: 该论文研究线性 bandit 中的“两全”（BOBW）算法，目标是在 T 轮内同时对对抗环境保证 Õ(√T) 遗憾、对随机环境保证 Õ(log T) 遗憾。针对有限动作集，作者提出“信息获取型跟随正则化领导者”（IAFTRL），这是首个完全基于 FTRL 框架、并在随机情形下达到 Õ(C* log T) 型遗憾界的 BOBW 算法，其中 C* 为信息获取量。论文进一步分析了信息获取、数据污染与几何结构之间的相互作用。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2611.01299v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We study \textit{best-of-both-worlds} (BOBW) algorithms for linear bandits, which aim to simultaneously guarantee $\gO(\sqrt T)$ regret in the adversarial regime and $\gO(\log T)$ regret in the stochastic regime over $T$ rounds. For finite action sets, we introduce \emph{information-acquisition follow-the-regularized-leader} (\IAFTRL{}), the first BOBW algorithm based purely on the follow-the-regularized-leader (FTRL) framework that attains an $\gO(\cstar\log T)$-type regret in the stochastic regime, where $\cstar$ is the information-acquisition…
items.why_zh: 用统一的 FTRL 框架同时拿下对抗与随机两种情形的最优遗憾界，简化了 bandit 算法的设计并厘清了信息获取与几何结构的耦合。
items.why_en: Attaining optimal regret in both adversarial and stochastic regimes within a single FTRL framework simplifies bandit algorithm design and clarifies how information acquisition couples with geometry.

items.title_zh: InformedXRD：为粉末衍射对称性分类建立可复现基准与物理约束评测
items.title_en: InformedXRD: Reproducible Benchmarks and Physics-Informed Evaluation for Powder Diffraction Symmetry Classification
items.summary_zh: 粉末衍射（PXRD）对称性分类的机器学习模型正被大规模训练，但该领域缺乏统一的评测标准：不同论文使用不同的实验档案子集、不同的目标分类体系、预处理与指标，且已发布的模型很少以可被重新打分的形式公开。为此，作者提出 InformedXRD 评测框架，由三部分组成，其中摘要详述的第一部分是 230 个空间群到 99 个消光组的机器可读映射，而消光组是粉末衍射所能识别的最细类别。该框架的目标是让不同模型在统一规范下可复现地比较。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2611.01525v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Machine learning for powder diffraction (PXRD) symmetry classification is being trained at scale, yet the field lacks a common evaluation standard: papers report results on different subsets of experimental archives, with different target taxonomies, preprocessing, and metrics, and published models are rarely released in a form that permits rescoring. We present InformedXRD, an evaluation framework with three parts: (i) a machine-readable mapping from 230 space groups to 99 extinction groups, the finest classes powder diffraction can identify fro…
items.why_zh: 缺少统一、可复现的评测规范，跨论文的 PXRD 对称性分类结果就无法比较，真实进展也难以判断。
items.why_en: Without a shared, reproducible evaluation protocol, reported PXRD symmetry-classification results cannot be compared and real progress is hard to gauge.

items.title_zh: 智能体记忆即速率受限滤波：显式状态在依赖读者的视野之外胜过超长上下文
items.title_en: Agent Memory as Rate-Limited Filtering: Explicit State Outlasts Long Context Beyond a Reader-Dependent Horizon
items.summary_zh: 研究提出一个可执行基准：让语言模型读取访问日志的完整历史，判断某项服务当前是否允许执行操作；任务涵盖授权、撤回、恢复、过期、分组与变更窗口，评分基于仅在事件顺序或某一决定字段上不同的历史对。结果显示，7B 至 32B 参数的开源模型在 8 或 16 个事件之后准确率为 72%–86%，到 256 个事件后降至 48%–55%；而读取当前状态、经推理训练的 32B 模型分别达到 96% 与 98%。作者据此把智能体记忆刻画为“速率受限滤波”，指出把记忆写成显式状态比把全部历史塞进上下文更有效，且存在一个取决于读者的有效视野边界。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2611.02361v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Can a language model that reads the full history of an access log say whether a service may act now? On an executable benchmark of grants, withdrawals, reinstatements, expiries, groups and change windows under a known policy, scored on pairs of histories that differ only in the order or one field of the deciding events, open models of 7 to 32 billion parameters fall from 72 to 86 percent after eight or sixteen events to 48 to 55 percent after 256, while reasoning-trained 32B models reading the current state reach 96 and 98 percent. A reasoning mo…
items.why_zh: 为“长上下文还是显式状态记忆”之争提供了可量化的实验证据与理论视角，直接影响智能体架构设计。
items.why_en: It gives quantified evidence and a theoretical lens to the long-context-versus-explicit-state debate, directly informing agent architecture design.

items.title_zh: MetaPOCS：面向预算感知地震数据插值的元学习多出口展开网络
items.title_en: MetaPOCS: Meta-Learned Multi-Exit Unfolding for Budget-Aware Seismic Data Interpolation
items.summary_zh: 地震数据插值必须在重建保真度与采集质控、后续成像所需的计算预算之间取得平衡；固定深度的展开网络只针对单一工作点优化，其中间估计往往训练不足，难以在早期或低预算场景中部署。作者提出 MetaPOCS，一个基于空间—频谱 POCS 重建骨干的元学习多出口展开框架，对中间阶段也施加监督，并保留已采集数据的一致性约束。这样模型可在不同算力预算下提前退出，给出可用的中间重建结果。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2611.02478v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Seismic data interpolation must reconcile reconstruction fidelity with the computational budgets of acquisition quality control and subsequent imaging. Fixed-depth unfolding networks are optimized for a single operating point, whereas their intermediate estimates may be insufficiently trained for early deployment. We present MetaPOCS, a meta-learned multi-exit unfolding framework for budget-aware seismic interpolation. Building on a spatial--spectral POCS reconstruction backbone, MetaPOCS supervises intermediate stages and preserves the acquired…
items.why_zh: 让地震插值能按可用算力灵活调节精度，兼顾质控时效与成像质量。
items.why_en: It lets seismic interpolation flexibly trade accuracy for available compute, balancing QC turnaround and imaging quality.

items.title_zh: 大规模神经系统中在线主动学习的端到端稳定性
items.title_en: End-to-End Stability of Online Active Learning in Large-Scale Neural Systems
items.summary_zh: 在线主动学习（OAL）把深度学习从“离线训练后静态推理”推进到“与变化的物理环境实时交互中持续适应”，这对安全攸关应用至关重要，但也带来一个核心理论问题：当在线参数更新扩展到多层神经网络结构时，这一过程是否仍然稳定。本文构建了以稳定性为中心的 OAL 框架，用预测误差作为反馈信号来更新结构化的深度模型，并据此分析在线更新的稳定性边界。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2611.02488v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Online Active Learning (OAL) aims to extend deep learning from static inference after offline training to continuous adaptation during real-time interaction with a changing physical environment. This transition is essential for safety-critical applications, but it raises a central theoretical question: whether the online parameter update process remains stable when scaled to multilayer neural architectures. This paper develops a stability-focused OAL framework. The framework uses prediction error as a feedback signal to update a structured deep m…
items.why_zh: 为在线持续学习能否安全地用于多层神经网络提供了以稳定性为核心的理论框架。
items.why_en: It offers a stability-centric theoretical framework for whether online continual learning can be safely deployed in multilayer neural systems.

items.title_zh: SpecPilot：为推测解码自动发现算法并做系统优化
items.title_en: SpecPilot: Autonomous Algorithm Discovery and Systems Optimization for Speculative Decoding
items.summary_zh: 推测解码用轻量草稿模型加速受内存带宽限制的 LLM 解码，并行草稿模型更进一步，通过一次前向生成整块草稿来提升加速比。但现有已发布系统是否真正吃到了并行草稿所能带来的全部加速仍不清楚。作者指出三类挑战：单请求场景下每步只接受少量 token 却要读取全部目标权重；批处理时逐请求的验证开销使相对自回归解码的加速大致减半；以及推测解码的其他系统瓶颈。SpecPilot 以自主算法发现与系统优化来针对性地弥补这些损耗。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2611.02501v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Speculative decoding accelerates memory-bound LLM decoding with a lightweight drafter, and parallel drafters extend this speedup by drafting a whole block in one forward pass. However, it remains unclear whether their released systems (stock) attain the full speedup that parallel drafting permits. We identify three challenges. First, with one request, each step accepts few tokens but reads every target weight. Second, with batching, per-request verification work roughly halves the speedup over autoregressive (AR) decoding. Third, speculative deco…
items.why_zh: 揭示推测解码“理论加速”与“实际加速”之间的差距，并用自动搜索弥补系统层面的损耗。
items.why_en: It exposes the gap between theoretical and realized speculative-decoding speedups and closes system-level losses through automated search.

items.title_zh: 从 PID 到强化学习：建筑暖通空调控制架构、整定策略与部署权衡综述
items.title_en: From PID to Reinforcement Learning in Building HVAC Control: A Control-Architecture Review of Tuning Strategies, Formulations, and Deployment Trade-offs
items.summary_zh: 该文综述建筑暖通空调（HVAC）系统的控制架构，围绕能源需求、 occupant 舒适度与设备可运行性之间的张力，把 PID 调节放在一个同时包含规则型控制、基于模型的监督控制和数据驱动强化学习（RL）的分层控制栈中考察。文章从双位控制与分时段设定点控制出发，逐层分析比例、PI 与 PID 调节及其整定方法这一“恒温器—PID”层。综述还比较各类控制范式的建模形式与部署取舍，为实际选型提供参考框架。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2611.03152v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: This paper reviews control architectures for building heating, ventilation and air-conditioning (HVAC) systems, addressing the tension among energy demand, occupant comfort and equipment operability, and situating proportional-integral-derivative (PID) regulation within a layered control stack that also includes rule-based and model-based supervisory control and data-driven reinforcement learning (RL). It examines the thermostat-PID layer from two-position and scheduled setpoint control through proportional, PI and PID regulation and their tuning…
items.why_zh: 为从传统 PID 迁移到强化学习的建筑控制实践提供了一张按架构层次组织的取舍地图。
items.why_en: It provides an architecture-level trade-off map for practitioners moving building HVAC control from PID to reinforcement learning.

items.title_zh: ViAdminShift：基于 2025 年行政区划改革的越南语事件级知识更新基准
items.title_en: ViAdminShift: A Vietnamese Benchmark for Event-Level Knowledge Updates Built from the 2025 Administrative Reform
items.summary_zh: 2025 年 7 月 1 日，越南将 63 个省缩减为 34 个，撤销 696 个郡级单位，并把 10,035 个乡级单位替换为 3,321 个。ViAdminShift 是围绕这一事件构建的越南语资源，包含 7,995 条评测样本、2,281 段取自改革前后维基百科版本与带日期模板的检索段落，以及可由发布脚本从官方转换表重建的新旧对照表（原表不再分发）。变更条目保存改革前的答案（121 条地址类条目除外），并采用 2×2 实验设计来区分不同类型的更新。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2611.03171v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: On July 1, 2025, Vietnam reduced its 63 provinces to 34, abolished its 696 districts, and replaced its 10,035 commune-level units (wards) with 3,321. ViAdminShift, a Vietnamese language resource about this event, consists of 7,995 benchmark items, 2,281 retrieval passages from pre- and post-reform Wikipedia revisions and dated templates, and old-to-new tables that a released script rebuilds from the official conversion table (not redistributed). Changed items store the pre-reform answer (except 121 address items), a $2\times2$ design uses untouch…
items.why_zh: 真实的行政区划突变提供了一个天然的事件级知识更新测试床，用来检验模型能否替换已过时的事实。
items.why_en: A real administrative overhaul offers a natural testbed for event-level knowledge updates, probing whether models can overwrite stale facts.

items.title_zh: 审视农田范围分割的 GeoFM 评测：标签代理、基线与冻结特征何时可比微调
items.title_en: Auditing GeoFM Evaluation for Field-Extent Segmentation: Label Proxies, Baselines, and When Frozen Features Match Fine-tuning
items.summary_zh: 面向农田范围分割的地理空间基础模型（GeoFM）基准，常依赖耕地土地覆盖数据作为“代理标签”，并与逐像元光谱基线比较。作者用来自六个国家的同一批单时相 Sentinel-2 像元，量化这些选择如何影响结论：把多边形派生的地块标签换成 ESA WorldCover 耕地后，随机森林的 AUROC 从 0.55–0.82 升至 0.79–0.96，说明代理标签把任务变成了一个在光谱上更易区分的任务。而在真实地块范围标签上，从零训练的 U-Net 表现则明显不同，提示此前评测可能高估了模型能力。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2611.00054v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Geospatial foundation-model (GeoFM) benchmarks for agricultural field-extent segmentation often rely on cropland land-cover proxies and compare against per-pixel spectral baselines. We measure how these choices affect conclusions using identical single-date Sentinel-2 pixels from six countries. Replacing polygon-derived field labels with ESA WorldCover cropland raises random-forest AUROC from 0.55-0.82 to 0.79-0.96, showing that the proxy creates a more spectrally separable task. On the actual field-extent labels, a from-scratch U-Net reaches 0…
items.why_zh: 说明代理标签会系统性改变任务难度并可能夸大模型表现，评测结论需要重新审视。
items.why_en: It shows label proxies systematically shift task difficulty and can inflate measured performance, so GeoFM evaluation conclusions need re-examination.

items.title_zh: 复现 INP-Former：重建内在正常原型用于工业异常检测
items.title_en: Reproducing INP-Former: Reconstructing Intrinsic Normal Prototypes for Industrial Anomaly Detection
items.summary_zh: 该研究复现了基于重建的多类工业异常检测方法 INP-Former。该方法从每张测试图像中提取“内在正常原型”（INP），用其引导解码器重建正常特征，无需存储记忆库。作者使用官方发布代码，在 MVTec AD 和 VisA 上复现了报告性能，并进一步在 MVTec AD 2 上评估：默认设置下图像 AUROC 为 63.4，而 MVTec AD 上为 99.7。摘要还提到在 MVTec AD 上进行五种子消融实验。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2611.01230v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We reproduce the central claims of INP-Former, a reconstruction-based method for multi-class industrial anomaly detection. INP-Former extracts Intrinsic Normal Prototypes (INPs) from each test image and uses them to guide a decoder that reconstructs normal features, without a stored memory bank. Using the authors' released code, we reproduce the reported performance on MVTec AD and VisA and extend the evaluation to MVTec AD 2, where image AUROC with the default settings is 63.4, compared with 99.7 on MVTec AD. On MVTec AD, a five-seed ablation…
items.why_zh: 复现验证了方法在经典基准上的有效性，同时揭示其在更新、更难基准上的泛化明显下降。
items.why_en: The reproduction confirms strong performance on established benchmarks while exposing a sharp generalization drop on the newer, harder MVTec AD 2.

items.title_zh: 代理流量回放中的有界保留历史：混合预测试点与分配研究
items.title_en: Bounded Retained History in a Proxy Flow Replay: A Mixed Predictive Pilot and an Allocation Study
items.summary_zh: 研究考察代理流量回放中“有界保留历史”的作用，数据来自整理后的 UNSW-NB15 流量镜像。实验按原始 ltime 时间戳构造人工释放顺序回放，同一时间戳的记录查询共享的先验组状态。试点中，加入保留关系特征的模型在侦察类召回上低于“当前流+计数器”基线（43.66% 对 47.84%），但在各自冻结阈值下良性误报率更低（3.63% 对 6.68%）。后续还进行了分配研究。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2611.02123v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We examine bounded retained history through a frozen predictive pilot and a subsequent allocation study on a curated UNSW-NB15 flow mirror. Both use an artificial release-order replay based on raw ltime ticks, with equal-tick records querying a shared prior-group state. In the pilot, the model with added retained relational features had lower reconnaissance recall than the current-flow-plus-counters baseline (43.66% versus 47.84%) and lower benign false-positive rate (3.63% versus 6.68%) at separately frozen operating thresholds, together with…
items.why_zh: 结果表明保留历史特征未必提升检测召回，却可能降低误报，需要权衡。
items.why_en: Retained-history features may trade detection recall for fewer false positives, highlighting a key design trade-off.

items.title_zh: 稀有有用特征的多分类：基本极限与多样性追踪 Higher Criticism 阈值的最优性
items.title_en: Multiclass Classification with Rare Useful Features: Fundamental Limits and the Optimality of Diversity Pursuit Higher Criticism Thresholding
items.summary_zh: 论文研究高维特征空间中的多分类问题：仅极小比例特征有用，且类别数可能很大。作者指出，多分类下“有用特征”可促进类别区分，却不一定能分开任何特定类别对，这与二分类的稀有弱特征理论不同。文章聚焦稀有特征多样性模型，并分析“多样性追踪 + Higher Criticism 阈值”方法的最优性及基本极限。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2611.02255v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We consider classification in high-dimensional feature spaces where only a vanishing fraction of features are useful and the number of classes may be large. While this rare-and-weak useful-feature regime is well understood in the binary setting, its multiclass version raises new questions: a feature can be useful for class discrimination without separating any specific pair of classes. We focus on a rare feature diversity model, in which most features are useless, but a small fraction promote discrimination among classes in a way that can be de…
items.why_zh: 为多分类中的稀有弱信号特征提供理论极限与阈值方法最优性依据。
items.why_en: It provides theoretical limits and optimality guarantees for thresholding methods in multiclass rare-and-weak feature settings.

items.title_zh: 排序正确、尺度错误：复现机器人世界模型动力学并检验其后续模型不确定性
items.title_en: Right Ranking, Wrong Scale: Reproducing the Robotic World Model's Dynamics Model and Testing the Uncertainty of Its Follow-up
items.summary_zh: 该工作复现了机器人世界模型（RWM）的动力学模型，并检验其后续工作 RWM-U 用于离线策略优化奖励惩罚的不确定性估计。复现实现与已发布模型的梯度一致；在留出数据上，用模型自身 rollout 训练在预注册的长时程上于全部十个回合优于单步训练，但在短单步窗口上落后。RWM-U 的集成分歧在排序 rollout 误差上优于预测步数（100 步时 Spearman ρ=0.90），但其分布尺度存在明显问题。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2611.02699v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: We reimplement the dynamics model of the Robotic World Model (RWM) and test the uncertainty estimate that its follow-up, RWM-U, uses to penalize reward in offline policy optimization. Our implementation matches the released model's gradients. On held-out data, training on the model's own rollouts beats one-step training at the preregistered long horizon for all ten episodes, but loses on short one-step windows. RWM-U's ensemble disagreement ranks rollout errors better than forecast step (Spearman rho = 0.90 at 100 steps), yet its spread substan…
items.why_zh: 复现揭示世界模型长时程训练优势与不确定性估计“排序准、尺度偏”的关键缺陷。
items.why_en: It exposes both the long-horizon benefit of world-model training and a key calibration flaw in the follow-up uncertainty estimate.

items.title_zh: 二阶序贯机器遗忘中的误差累积
items.title_en: Error Accumulation in Second-Order Sequential Machine Unlearning
items.summary_zh: 论文研究序贯机器遗忘中的误差累积问题：删除请求随时间到达，反复更新会累积近似误差。作者关注高维情形，即参数数量 p 与样本量 n 成正比，并分析二阶遗忘方法在两种隐私设置下的表现。其中“部分遗忘”允许保留未公开内部状态，同时发布经过认证的模型版本。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2611.03445v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Machine unlearning seeks to remove the influence of deleted training data without full retraining. In the sequential setting, deletion requests arrive over time, and repeated updates can accumulate approximation errors. In this paper, we study error accumulation in high dimensions, where parameter count $p$ is proportional to sample size $n$, for second-order unlearning methods under two privacy settings: (i) \emph{partial unlearning}, which allows unpublished internal states to be retained while certified versions of the model are released; an…
items.why_zh: 为频繁删除场景下遗忘算法的长期可靠性提供误差累积分析。
items.why_en: It offers an error-accumulation analysis for the long-term reliability of unlearning under repeated deletion requests.

items.title_zh: 匹配市场中基于超级稳定性的竞争型多臂老虎机
items.title_en: Competing Bandits in Matching Markets via Super Stability
items.summary_zh: 论文研究匹配市场中的 bandit 学习，且双侧奖励均存在不确定性，扩展了以往主要关注单侧不确定性的工作。作者基于 Irving（1994）的超级稳定性概念和 Cseh 与 Juhos（2021）的部分序提案算法，用同时进行的扩展 Gale-Shapley 过程，在不完整偏好信息下认证稳定匹配。其集中式算法达到对数级的最差稳定遗憾，依赖于实例相关的可接受间隙参数。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2506.15926v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We study bandit learning in matching markets with two-sided reward uncertainty, extending prior research primarily focused on single-sided uncertainty. Building on Irving's (1994) concept of super-stability and the partial-order proposal algorithm of Cseh and Juhos (2021), we use a simultaneous Extended Gale-Shapley procedure to certify stable matchings from incomplete preference information. By employing this procedure, our centralized algorithm attains logarithmic pessimal stable regret dependent on an instance-dependent admissible gap para…
items.why_zh: 把稳定匹配与双侧不确定 bandit 结合，给出可认证稳定匹配与遗憾界。
items.why_en: It combines stable matching with two-sided uncertainty bandits and provides certified stable matchings with regret guarantees.

items.title_zh: 如何充分利用掩码语言模型进行蛋白质工程
items.title_en: How to make the most of your masked language model for protein engineering
items.summary_zh: 近年来蛋白质语言模型大量发布，但如何从这些模型中采样以优化目标生物性质的研究相对较少。作者为掩码语言模型（MLM）提出一种灵活有效的采样方法，并在实际抗体药物研发项目中，于计算机模拟和体外实验两个层面系统评估模型与方法。其核心是随机束搜索采样，利用 MLM 在评估序列概率方面的高效性。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2603.10302v4 Announce Type: replace Abstract: A plethora of protein language models have been released in recent years. Yet comparatively little work has addressed how to best sample from them to optimize desired biological properties. We fill this gap by proposing a flexible, effective sampling method for masked language models (MLMs), and by systematically evaluating models and methods both in silico and in vitro on actual antibody therapeutics campaigns. Firstly, we propose sampling with stochastic beam search, exploiting the fact that MLMs are remarkably efficient at evaluating the p…
items.why_zh: 为蛋白质工程提供可落地的 MLM 采样策略，并在真实抗体项目中验证。
items.why_en: It provides a practical MLM sampling strategy for protein engineering and validates it in real antibody campaigns.

items.title_zh: 推进开放可复现的关系学习：RelArena-α、TabPFN-Rel 与 RPI
items.title_en: Advancing Open and Reproducible Relational Learning: RelArena-$\alpha$, TabPFN-Rel and RPI
items.summary_zh: Prior Labs 发布其在关系学习领域的首个成果，强调对开放科学的承诺。团队开源了三款软件——RelArena-α、TabPFN-Rel 和 RPI，期望加速关系学习研究并推动现实影响。由于仍处早期阶段，此次 α 版本主要面向研究人员和早期采用者，并希望基于社区反馈与合作继续改进。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2608.16319v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: This first release of Prior Labs in relational learning shows our continued commitment to open science. We open-source three pieces of software that we expect to accelerate research in the field towards meaningful real-world impact. We aim to steer further development based on feedback from, and in collaboration with, the community. Given the early stage of development, our $\alpha$-release targets researchers and early-adopting practitioners. Over the past years, a variety of datasets and tasks for relational learning have emerged, but the c…
items.why_zh: 通过开源基准、模型与工具提升关系学习的可复现性与研究协作。
items.why_en: Open-sourcing benchmarks, models, and tools improves reproducibility and collaboration in relational learning.

items.title_zh: AI 生成的代码补丁安全吗？基于 SWE-bench 的大规模安全风险研究
items.title_en: How Safe Are AI-Generated Patches? A Large-scale Study on Security Risks in LLM and Agentic Automated Program Repair on SWE-bench
items.summary_zh: 这篇论文（arXiv:2507.02976v4）对 LLM 与智能体框架自动生成的代码补丁开展了大规模安全分析，数据规模为 SWE-bench 中 2 万余个 GitHub issue。研究对比了三类补丁：开发者手写的补丁、由两个独立 LLM（Llama 3.3 Instruct-70B 与 GPT-5.4 nano）生成的补丁，以及四个智能体框架（OpenHands、AutoCodeRover、Honey 等）生成的补丁。作者指出，以往关于 LLM 生成代码安全风险的研究多集中在合成、简化或孤立的任务上，缺乏对真实软件工程流程的评估，因此本文把分析放到更贴近实际的自动程序修复场景中。摘要未披露具体漏洞比例等结论细节，但其设定的评估口径为衡量自动修 bug 工具能否安全落地提供了基准。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2507.02976v4 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) and agentic frameworks are increasingly used for development tasks such as automated program repair (APR). Prior work has identified security risks in LLM-generated code, but most studies focus on synthetic, simplified, or isolated tasks. We present a large-scale security analysis of LLM-generated patches using 20,000+ GitHub issues from SWE-bench. We evaluate developer-written patches, two standalone LLMs (Llama 3.3 Instruct-70B and GPT-5.4 nano), and four agentic frameworks (OpenHands, AutoCodeRover, Honey…
items.why_zh: AI 自动修复代码正被广泛采用，补丁是否会引入新的安全漏洞直接关系到软件供应链的可信度。
items.why_en: As AI-driven automated program repair spreads, whether generated patches introduce new vulnerabilities directly affects software supply-chain trust.

items.title_zh: OpenSR-SRGAN：面向多光谱对地观测数据的灵活超分辨率框架
items.title_en: OpenSR-SRGAN: A Flexible Super-Resolution Framework for Multispectral Earth Observation Data
items.summary_zh: 卫星影像往往包含可见光红、绿、蓝之外的多光谱测量信息，但其空间分辨率对部分应用而言过于粗糙，超分辨率方法正是从这些粗分辨率观测中估计更精细的影像。OpenSR-SRGAN 是一个模块化、配置驱动的框架，用于在多光谱对地观测数据上训练与基准测试此类模型。该软件允许用户以简洁的配置方式，在任意传感器波段组合上训练和评估可配置的生成器—判别器架构。它定位于为遥感超分辨率研究提供统一、可复现的实验工具链。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2511.10461v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Satellite images often contain useful measurements beyond visible red, green and blue light, but at a spatial resolution that is too coarse for some applications. Super-resolution methods estimate a finer-resolution image from these coarse observations. OpenSR-SRGAN is a modular, configuration-driven framework for training and benchmarking such models on multispectral Earth-observation data. The software enables users to train and evaluate configurable generator-discriminator architectures on arbitrary sensor band setups using concise Y…
items.why_zh: 遥感超分辨率缺乏统一的训练与评测工具，该框架以配置化方式降低了多光谱模型复现与对比的门槛。
items.why_en: Remote-sensing super-resolution lacks unified training and benchmarking tooling; this configuration-driven framework lowers the barrier to reproducing and comparing multispectral models.

items.title_zh: 是几何结构在起作用吗？对双曲视觉-语言模型层级结构的工作点审计
items.title_en: Is the Geometry Doing the Work? An Operating-Point Audit of Hierarchy in Hyperbolic Vision-Language Models
items.summary_zh: 双曲视觉-语言模型的设计初衷是用几何方式编码抽象层级：一般概念靠近原点，具体概念更靠外，蕴含锥表示有向的包含关系。该研究追问经训练的 MERU、HyCoCLIP 与 PHyCLIP 模型是否真的用上了这些机制，为此审计了七个公开 checkpoint，并做了匹配的从头训练干预实验。结果显示，所有审计的已收敛 checkpoint 在无量纲半径 u=√c·ρ 上仍接近欧氏几何，图像侧观测到的最大值仅为 0.37，远低于约 0.84 的阈值。这提示模型可能并未真正进入双曲区域，所谓层级能力未必来自几何结构。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2607.05268v4 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Hyperbolic vision-language models are designed to encode abstraction geometrically: general concepts near the origin, specific ones farther out, and entailment cones representing directed order. We ask whether trained MERU, HyCoCLIP, and PHyCLIP models actually use these mechanisms. We audit seven released checkpoints and matched from-scratch interventions. All audited converged checkpoints remain near-Euclidean in the dimensionless radius $u=\sqrt{c}\rho$: the largest observed image-side value is $0.37$ -- well below $u\approx0.84$, wh…
items.why_zh: 它质疑双曲表示模型的性能提升是否真由双曲几何带来，提醒社区区分“架构声称”与“实际生效的机制”。
items.why_en: It questions whether hyperbolic models' gains actually come from hyperbolic geometry, urging the community to separate architectural claims from mechanisms that really operate.

items.title_zh: 几何复杂度增长下的非参数上下文学习：Transformer 的极小极大最优性与局部几何自适应性
items.title_en: Nonparametric In-Context Learning under Growing Geometric Complexity: Minimax Optimality and Local Geometry-Adaptivity of Transformers
items.summary_zh: Transformer 已成为上下文学习（ICL）的核心架构，大语言模型的表现尤其突出，这也促使研究者理解它如何利用真实数据的内在几何结构。然而现有非参数 ICL 理论多集中在简化设定上，例如欧氏域或单一流形模型，难以完整解释其在复杂任务上的实证成功。为弥补这一空白，作者研究了未知几何条件下的预测问题，提出在几何复杂度增长的情形下分析 Transformer 的 ICL 能力，并给出极小极大最优性与局部几何自适应性的理论刻画。
items.summary_en: arXiv:2609.31458v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Transformers have become a central architecture for in-context learning (ICL), particularly through their state-of-the-art performance in large language models. This success motivates understanding how transformers exploit intrinsic geometry of real-world data. However, existing nonparametric ICL theory has largely focused on simplified settings, such as Euclidean domains or single manifold models, failing to fully explain its phenomenal empirical success in complex tasks. To address this gap, we study the prediction problem under unkno…
items.why_zh: 它把 ICL 理论从欧氏、单流形的简化假设推进到更贴近真实数据的复杂几何，为理解大模型的上下文学习能力提供更坚实的解释。
items.why_en: It pushes ICL theory beyond Euclidean and single-manifold assumptions toward the complex geometries of real data, offering a firmer explanation of large models' in-context learning.

items.title_zh: AvePoint 推出 Trust 平台，强化 AI 治理、安全与成本优化
items.title_en: AvePoint Launches Trust Platform to Strengthen AI Governance, Security, and Cost Optimization

items.why_en: As enterprise AI matures, governance, security, and cost control are becoming a software category of their own rather than an afterthought.

items.title_zh: AI 制药公司“同构实验室”总裁贾德伯格大胆预测：未来所有药物都将由 AI 设计
items.title_en: Isomorphic Labs President Predicts All Future Drugs Will Be Designed by AI
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 3 日消息，据彭博社报道，人工智能制药公司同构实验室总裁马克斯 · 贾德伯格相信， 未来所有药物都将由 AI 设计 ，区别只在于这一目标需要多久才能实现。“这一天肯定会到来。我毫不怀疑，未来所有药物都会由 AI 设计。我只是不希望大家被动等待，结果要过 20 年甚至 50 年才能实现。” 当地时间 2 日，贾德伯格在伦敦举行的彭博科技大会上介绍，实验室希望通过 AI 提高新药研发的速度和效率，目前仍处于临床前试验阶段，公司的发展也才刚刚起步。 今年 1 月，同构实验室 CEO 德米斯 · 哈萨比斯曾透露，公司计划年底前启动首批临床试验。 同构实验室由 Alphabet 旗下的 谷歌 DeepMind 分拆成立 ，除了利用 AI 模型自主研发药物，还为礼来、诺华等生物制药企业提供药物研发技术。 同构实验室累计融资约 27 亿美元 （IT之家注：现汇率约合 179.97 亿元人民币） ，投资方包括 Alphabet 和 Thrive Capital。该公司近期正洽谈新一轮融资，估值有望达到 400 亿美元 （现汇率约合 2,666.16 亿元人民币） 或更高。今年 5 月公布上一轮融资时，同构实验室并未透露公司估值。 同构实验室成立于 2021 年，由当时担任谷歌 DeepMind CEO 的哈萨比斯领导，希望在蛋白质结构预测模型 AlphaFold 取得的突破基础…
items.summary_en: Max Jaderberg, president of AI drug-discovery startup Isomorphic Labs, told Bloomberg's tech conference in London that all future drugs will eventually be designed by AI, and urged the industry not to wait decades for it. The Google DeepMind spin-out, which raised about $2.7 billion and is reportedly in talks at a valuation of $400 billion or more, is still in preclinical stages while CEO Demis Hassabis has said first clinical trials could start by year-end.
items.why_zh: 若 AI 设计药物成为常态，新药研发的成本、周期与产业格局都将被重塑。
items.why_en: If AI-designed drugs become the norm, the cost, timeline and competitive landscape of drug development could be fundamentally reshaped.

items.title_zh: 苹果 CEO 特努斯：Siri 每日处理超过 25 亿次请求，部分高级 AI 功能将收费
items.title_en: Apple CEO Ternus: Siri Handles Over 2.5 Billion Requests a Day, Some Advanced AI Features Will Be Paid
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 3 日消息，科技媒体 AppleInsider 今天（11 月 3 日）发布博文，报道称在最新财报电话会议上， 苹果首席执行官约翰 · 特努斯（John Ternus）重申 Siri 每天处理超过 25 亿次请求 ，部分高级 AI 功能将收费。 IT之家注：这并非苹果公司首次宣布该数据，在 9 月召开的 iPhone 18 Pro 系列以及其首款折叠 iPhone Duo 发布活动中，苹果公司人工智能产品营销副总裁莉莲 · 林孔（Lilian Rincon）首次披露了该数据。 相比 2024 年 WWDC 公布的“每天 15 亿次语音请求”，最新数字高出逾 10 亿次，不过苹果并未说明两次统计口径是否一致。 苹果正借这一庞大用户基础推进 Siri 的 AI 化改造。新版 Siri 已随 iOS 27 于 9 月起逐步推出，能够结合个人上下文理解更复杂的问题，并跨应用执行操作；它还可从信息、邮件和照片中检索内容，帮助用户不必记住信息具体存放在哪个应用或对话中。 但新体验尚未全面开放。Siri AI 仍处于测试阶段，符合条件的用户需加入等候名单；部分依赖服务器端 AI 模型的功能设有每日使用上限，而未来用户如果想要更频繁使用，需要支付一定的费用。
items.summary_en: Apple CEO John Ternus said on the company's earnings call that Siri handles more than 2.5 billion requests per day, up from the 1.5 billion voice requests cited at WWDC 2024, and confirmed that some advanced AI features will be paid. The new AI-powered Siri, rolling out with iOS 27, can use personal context and act across apps, but remains in testing with waitlists and daily caps on server-side features.
items.why_zh: 这是苹果首次明确把生成式 AI 能力直接变现，其定价方式将影响数亿 iPhone 用户的使用体验。
items.why_en: It marks Apple's first clear move to monetize generative AI directly, with pricing decisions likely to shape the experience of hundreds of millions of iPhone users.

items.title_zh: OpenAI 下一代 GPT-6.2 Astra 正灰度测试，Codex 用量统计中已单独列出
items.title_en: OpenAI's Next-Gen GPT-6.2 Astra Reportedly in Limited A/B Testing, Listed Separately in Codex Usage Stats
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 3 日消息，经大量用户反馈，OpenAI 下一代模型 GPT-6.2 Astra 疑似已进入小范围测试，部分 Codex 用户的使用量统计中已经出现独立模型标识「gpt-6.2-astra」。 不过，截至目前，OpenAI 官方 API 模型目录、更新日志及公开公告均未确认这一型号，OpenAI 也没有确认其发布时间。 据科技媒体 TestingCatalog 昨日报道，多个 Codex 用户在使用量分析页面发现了这一新模型标识。不同用户分享的截图显示，GPT-6.2 Astra 已经占据部分账户的模型调用量，IT之家注意到其中一个账户的占比达到 19.8%（相关记录主要出现在 10 月 31 日的使用统计中）。 TestingCatalog 认为，这些记录可能意味着 OpenAI 正在进行灰度测试或 A/B 测试，即让部分用户的请求在后台转发至新模型，同时暂时保留原有的界面名称。 作为背景，OpenAI 于 2026 年 9 月 3 日发布 GPT-6 Astra。根据 Terminal-Bench 4.0 测试成绩，GPT-6 Astra 得分为 57.9%，Claude Fable 5.1 为 55.8%，但 Terminal-Bench 官方排行榜目前列出的数据分别为 58.2% 和 57.9%，两者差距较小，具体成绩还会受到推理强度和测试配置影响。 此…
items.summary_en: Users have spotted a separate model label, "gpt-6.2-astra," in Codex usage dashboards, with one account showing 19.8% of calls routed to it, mostly on Oct 31. OpenAI has not confirmed the model in its API catalog, changelogs or announcements, and TestingCatalog suggests it may be a gray-scale or A/B test that keeps the original interface name. OpenAI released GPT-6 Astra on Sept 3, 2026, which scored 57.9% on Terminal-Bench 4.0 versus 55.8% for Claude Fable 5.1.
items.why_zh: 若情况属实，说明 OpenAI 已在真实流量中试跑下一代模型，模型迭代与竞争节奏进一步加快。
items.why_en: If confirmed, it means OpenAI is already testing its next model on live traffic, signaling an even faster cadence in model releases and competition.

items.title_zh: 豪掷 457.65 亿美元：苹果 2026 财年研发费用同比增 32% 创历史新高，加码 AI 投入
items.title_en: Apple's FY2026 R&D Spending Hits Record $45.77 Billion, Up 32% Year Over Year
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 3 日消息，科技媒体 9to5Mac 今天（11 月 3 日）发布博文，报道称基于官方披露数据，2026 财年（2025 年 9 月 28 日～2026 年 9 月 26 日）第四财季（2026 年 6 月 28 日–9 月 26 日）苹果研发费用为 117.30 亿美元 （IT之家注：现汇率约合 781.85 亿元人民币） ，上年同期为 88.66 亿美元 （现汇率约合 590.95 亿元人民币） ，同比增长约 32.3%； 2026 全财年研发费用为 457.65 亿美元 （现汇率约合 3,050.42 亿元人民币） ，上年为 345.50 亿美元 （现汇率约合 2,302.89 亿元人民币） ， 同比增长 32.46%，并创历史新高。 注：上图源自 9to5Mac，最末应该是 Q4，第三财季（3 月 28 日 ~6 月 27 日）研发费用为 117.29 亿美元 （现汇率约合 781.78 亿元人民币） 在财报电话会议上，苹果首席财务官凯万 · 帕雷克（Kevan Parekh）表示，苹果公司本财季运营支出为 192 亿美元 （现汇率约合 1,279.76 亿元人民币） ，同比增长 21%，其中很大原因在于“持续加大研发投入”，进一步在芯片、产品、AI 及相关基础设施上扩张研发投资。 对于 2027 财年第一财季（9 月到 12 月），帕雷克预估运营支出为…
items.summary_en: Apple's R&D spending reached $11.73 billion in its fiscal Q4 2026, up about 32.3% from $8.87 billion a year earlier, bringing full-year FY2026 R&D to a record $45.77 billion, up 32.46% from $34.55 billion. CFO Kevan Parekh said quarterly operating expenses rose 21% to $19.2 billion, driven largely by continued increases in R&D across chips, products, AI and related infrastructure.
items.why_zh: 研发投入创历史新高且增速明显加快，显示苹果正加码 AI 与自研芯片等长期赌注。
items.why_en: Record and sharply accelerating R&D spending shows Apple is doubling down on long-term bets including AI and in-house silicon.

items.title_zh: Anthropic 营收逼近 170 亿美元，IPO 渐行渐近
items.title_en: Anthropic Revenue Nears $17 Billion as IPO Looms
items.summary_zh: 据彭博社报道，Anthropic 的营收规模正逼近 170 亿美元，与此同时公司的 IPO 进程日益临近。报道将营收的快速攀升与上市预期放在一起讨论，但摘要信息有限，具体的营收统计口径、统计区间以及上市时间表等细节尚未披露。对这家被视为头部大模型厂商之一公司而言，营收体量与上市动向都是外界关注的焦点。
items.summary_en: Anthropic Revenue Nears $17 Billion as IPO Looms Bloomberg.com
items.why_zh: 营收规模与 IPO 进程是观察头部 AI 公司商业化能力和资本市场态度的关键窗口。
items.why_en: Revenue scale and IPO progress are key gauges of how well leading AI companies can commercialize and how public markets view them.

items.why_en: Growth at this scale shows AI assistants rapidly reaching mainstream users and reshaping the rankings of top apps.

items.title_zh: OpenAI Tibo“28 天更新挑战”以两次重置收尾，共 14 天发放 Codex / ChatGPT Work 额度重置
items.title_en: OpenAI's Tibo Wraps Up 28-Day Update Challenge With Back-to-Back Resets, 14 Reset Days in Total
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 3 日消息，OpenAI Codex 与 ChatGPT Work 团队负责人 Thibault Sottiaux（Tibo）发起的「28 天更新挑战」已于 11 月 2 日正式结束。 这项挑战最终以 11 月 1 日、11 月 2 日连续两天发放“额度重置卡”收尾，分别对应挑战第 27 天和第 28 天。 Tibo 于北京时间 10 月 5 日在 X 上宣布开启“28 天挑战”，在未来 28 天内每天推出一项对大多数 Codex / ChatGPT Work 用户而言具有实际意义的明显改进，否则就向用户发放一次完整额度重置。 IT之家注：最后两天重置并不代表整个 28 天挑战期间只发放过两次额度重置。第三方追踪网站 Did Codex Reset 显示此期间有 14 天提供重置（部分天数里同时提供功能更新和重置），其中第 27 天和第 28 天均属于预存重置。 这项挑战主要围绕产品功能、运行效率、使用额度和模型更新展开。期间，OpenAI 陆续推出多项改进，也多次向用户发放完整额度重置。 根据第三方追踪网站的记录，Tibo 在第 26 天（10 月 30 日）时提前宣布接下来的两天将发放预存额度重置（Banked Reset）。随后，第 27 天和第 28 天分别兑现一次，完成最后两次重置。 Tibo 此次挑战的核心承诺并非每天无条件增加使用额度，而是要求团队…
items.summary_en: Thibault Sottiaux, who leads OpenAI's Codex and ChatGPT Work teams, closed his "28-day update challenge" on Nov 2, ending with quota resets handed out on both Nov 1 and Nov 2 (days 27 and 28). The challenge promised a meaningful improvement for most users every day for 28 days, or a full quota reset instead. A third-party tracker, Did Codex Reset, counted 14 reset days across the period, with the final two being banked resets.
items.why_zh: 以公开承诺倒逼每日交付，折射出 AI 产品团队高频迭代与用户运营的新打法。
items.why_en: Using a public pledge to force daily shipping highlights a new playbook of rapid iteration and user engagement in AI product teams.

items.title_zh: 苹果为第四代 Apple TV 4K 推送专属 24K154 更新，可启用 Siri AI
items.title_en: Apple Pushes Exclusive 24K154 tvOS Update to Fourth-Gen Apple TV 4K, Enabling Siri AI
items.summary_zh: IT之家 11 月 3 日消息，科技媒体 9to5Mac 昨日（11 月 2 日）发布博文，报道称在 Apple TV 4K（第四代）11 月 13 日上市开售之前， 苹果悄然为其推送专属 tvOS 27.2 更新。 版本号方面，该版本内部代号为 24K154，而 上周面向现有 Apple TV 设备推出的 tvOS 27.2 版本号为 24K122 ，意味着新款 Apple TV 4K 上市后将预装更新的系统版本。 在更新内容方面，苹果公司尚未单独公布 24K154 内容，不过开发者 @itspdfu 指出，在该版本中，苹果为新款 Apple TV 4K 适配启用 Siri AI。 在模拟 Apple TV 4K（第四代）的 Siri 设置中，相关说明写道：“Siri 比以往任何时候都更加强大，它结合了个人背景和世界知识，可以帮助你找到完美的节目，只需提问即可获取更多信息等等”。IT之家附上相关截图如下：
items.summary_en: Ahead of the fourth-gen Apple TV 4K going on sale Nov 13, Apple quietly released an exclusive tvOS 27.2 build, 24K154, which is newer than the 24K122 build rolled out to existing devices last week. Apple has not detailed the changes, but developer @itspdfu notes the build enables Siri AI on the new hardware, with Siri combining personal context and world knowledge to help find shows.
items.why_zh: 新机预装专属系统并启用 Siri AI，显示苹果正把 AI 能力延伸到客厅等更多设备。
items.why_en: A device-specific build that switches on Siri AI shows Apple extending AI features to more devices, including the living room.
